Be merciful to me, God, for man wants to swallow me up. All day long, he attacks and oppresses me.
My enemies want to swallow me up all day long, for they are many who fight proudly against me.

translations.web: Let’s swallow them up alive like Sheol, and whole, like those who go down into the pit.
translations.bsb: let us swallow them alive like Sheol, and whole like those descending into the Pit.
